notes:
v1.0.82 - Real-time Installed list + Games to Mods global browser + faster CurseForge:
1) INSTALLED LIST IS REAL-TIME: ghost duplicates (e.g. seven FPS Boost rows) are deduplicated
   automatically, and every window focus re-verifies against disk - a mod deleted externally
   disappears instantly, a dropped jar appears instantly. No restart, no stale cache.
2) NEW GAMES - MODS GLOBAL BROWSER: browse Modrinth AND CurseForge for any Minecraft version
   with a loader filter (Any/Fabric/Forge) - mods, resource packs, data packs, shaders and
   WORLDS (1-block, skyblocks, maps). Clicking Install/Download opens a clean instance picker
   with search, per-instance icon/version/loader, and the EXACT version that will be installed.
   Forge items can never be dropped into Fabric instances (and vice versa); Vanilla instances
   cannot take mods. Worlds install straight into saves/ with their own detail page (gallery,
   description, size). A Use Current Instance shortcut installs in one click.
3) NAVIGATION: Library now holds Instances + Downloads; Games holds Mods + Modpacks.
4) INSTANCE CONTROLS IN THE MODS SCREEN: Play/Stop, Edit, Share and a 3-dot menu (open
   folder / repair Fabric / duplicate / delete) - no leaving the screen to launch.
5) CURSEFORGE IS FAST AGAIN: response caching + a keep-warm ping every 5 min + warm-up on
   launch end the minutes-long first-load freeze (proxy cold boots).
6) RIGHT-CLICK MENU FIXED: the instance context menu now opens under the cursor (was
   rendering mid-screen) and never overflows the screen edge.
7) Mod detail/preview loads are cached (Modrinth + CurseForge) for instant re-opens.
